  "clinic_id": "2b3c4d5e-6f7a-8b9c-0d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e"
}
\end{lstlisting}

\textbf{Validation Rules}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{3cm} L{4cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \tblhdr{Field} & \tblhdr{Rules} & \tblhdr{Notes} \\
    \midrule
    \texttt{name}      & required, string           & Full display name. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{email}     & required, email, unique    & Unique across \texttt{users} table. \\
    \texttt{password}  & required, string, min:8    & Stored as Bcrypt hash. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{role}      & required, in:super\_admin,doctor,assistant
                                                    & Must be a valid \phpclass{UserRole} value. \\
    \texttt{clinic\_id}& required\_unless:role,super\_admin, exists:clinics,id
                                                    & Must reference an existing clinic. Not
                                                      required for Super Admin accounts. \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

\textbf{Success Response --- HTTP 201 Created}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "User created successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id":        "5e6f7a8b-9c0d-1e2f-3a4b-5c6d7e8f9a0b",
    "name":      "Dr. Omar Farouk",
    "email":     "omar.farouk@clinic-b.example.com",

    "is_active": true,
    "clinic_id": "2b3c4d5e-6f7a-8b9c-0d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e",
    "clinic": {
      "id":   "2b3c4d5e-6f7a-8b9c-0d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e",
      "name": "Delta Health Clinic"
    }
  }
}
\end{lstlisting}

\subsection{Delete User}
\label{ep:admin-users-destroy}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{3cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}

    \midrule
    Authentication & Bearer token required \\
    \rowalt
    Role Required  & \texttt{super\_admin} \\
    Path Param     & \texttt{id} --- UUID of the user \\
    \rowalt
    Success Status & \stok{} \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

Permanently deletes the user account and all Passport tokens belonging
to it. Historical appointments and prescriptions created by this user
retain the \texttt{doctor\_id} / \texttt{booked\_by} foreign key value
but the user record itself is removed.

\textbf{Success Response --- HTTP 200 OK}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "User deleted successfully.",
  "data":    []
}
\end{lstlisting}

%% =========================================================================
\section{Doctor Endpoints}
\label{sec:ep-doctor}
%% =========================================================================

All Doctor endpoints are grouped under the \route{/api/v1/doctor/}
prefix and require both the \texttt{role:doctor} middleware and the
\texttt{clinic.scope} middleware. Every response is automatically
constrained to the authenticated doctor's own clinic.

%% ── EP-DOC-1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\subsection{List Doctor Schedules}
\label{ep:doctor-schedules-index}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}

    \midrule
    Authentication & Bearer token required \\
    \rowalt

    Clinic Scope   & Enforced --- only the authenticated doctor's schedules \\
    \rowalt

\end{table}

%% ── EP-DOC-2 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\subsection{Create Doctor Schedule}
\label{ep:doctor-schedules-store}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{3cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\tblhdr{POST \quad /api/v1/doctor/schedules}} \\
    \midrule
    Authentication & Bearer token required \\
    \rowalt
    Role Required  & \texttt{doctor} \\
    Clinic Scope   & Enforced \\
    \rowalt
    Success Status & \stcreated{} \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

Creates a new weekly schedule entry for the authenticated doctor. At
most one schedule entry per \texttt{day\_of\_week} is permitted; the
database enforces a unique constraint on
\texttt{(doctor\_id, day\_of\_week)}.

\textbf{Request Body}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "day_of_week":   2,
  "start_time":    "08:00",
  "end_time":      "13:00",
  "slot_duration": 20
}
\end{lstlisting}

\textbf{Validation Rules}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{3.5cm} L{3.5cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \tblhdr{Field} & \tblhdr{Rules} & \tblhdr{Notes} \\
    \midrule
    \texttt{day\_of\_week}   & required, integer, between:0,6
                               & 0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{start\_time}     & required, date\_format:H:i
                               & 24-hour format. \\
    \texttt{end\_time}       & required, date\_format:H:i, after:start\_time
                               & Must be strictly after \texttt{start\_time}. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{slot\_duration}  & required, integer, min:5
                               & Duration in minutes; minimum 5. \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

\textbf{Success Response --- HTTP 201 Created}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Schedule created successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id":            "8b9c0d1e-2f3a-4b5c-6d7e-8f9a0b1c2d3e",
    "doctor_id":     "9d2b1f4e-3a7c-4e8d-b1f2-3a7c4e8db1f2",
    "clinic_id":     "1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d",
    "day_of_week":   2,
    "start_time":    "08:00",
    "end_time":      "13:00",
    "slot_duration": 20
  }
}
\end{lstlisting}

\subsection{Update Appointment Status}
\label{ep:doctor-appointments-status}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{3cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\tblhdr{PATCH \quad /api/v1/doctor/appointments/\{id\}/status}} \\
    \midrule
    Authentication & Bearer token required \\
    \rowalt
    Role Required  & \texttt{doctor} \\
    Path Param     & \texttt{id} --- UUID of the appointment \\
    \rowalt
    Allowed Transitions & \texttt{pending} $\to$ \texttt{confirmed},
                          \texttt{confirmed} $\to$ \texttt{completed} \\
    \rowalt
    Success Status & \stok{} \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

Advances the appointment's status along the allowed transition path.
Any other transition (e.g.\ \texttt{completed} $\to$ \texttt{confirmed},
or any transition from \texttt{cancelled}) raises an
\phpclass{InvalidAppointmentStateException} (\stunproc{}).

\textbf{Request Body}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "status": "confirmed"
}
\end{lstlisting}

\textbf{Success Response --- HTTP 200 OK}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Appointment status updated successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id":               "9c0d1e2f-3a4b-5c6d-7e8f-9a0b1c2d3e4f",
    "appointment_date": "2026-07-01",
    "start_time":       "09:00",
    "end_time":         "09:30",
    "status":           "confirmed",
    "doctor_id":        "9d2b1f4e-3a7c-4e8d-b1f2-3a7c4e8db1f2",
    "patient_id":       "0d1e2f3a-4b5c-6d7e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a"
  }
}
\end{lstlisting}

\textbf{Error Response --- HTTP 422 (invalid transition)}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "This appointment cannot be transitioned to the requested status."
}
\end{lstlisting}

\subsection{Create Prescription}
\label{ep:doctor-prescriptions-store}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{3cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\tblhdr{POST \quad /api/v1/doctor/prescriptions}} \\
    \midrule
    Authentication & Bearer token required \\
    \rowalt
    Role Required  & \texttt{doctor} \\
    Clinic Scope   & Enforced \\
    \rowalt
    Restrictions   & (1) The authenticated doctor must be the doctor on the
                     referenced appointment. (2) The appointment must not be
                     in \texttt{cancelled} status. \\
    \rowalt
    Success Status & \stcreated{} \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

Creates a prescription header and one or more item records in a single
database transaction. The prescription is permanently linked to the
specified appointment.

\textbf{Request Body}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "appointment_id": "9c0d1e2f-3a4b-5c6d-7e8f-9a0b1c2d3e4f",
  "diagnosis":      "Lumbar disc herniation, L4-L5.",
  "notes":          "Patient advised to rest and avoid heavy lifting for 4 weeks.",
  "items": [
    {
      "medicine_name": "Ibuprofen",
      "dosage":        "400mg",
      "frequency":     "Three times daily after meals",
      "duration":      "7 days",
      "notes":         "Take with food to avoid gastric irritation."
    },
    {
      "medicine_name": "Diclofenac Gel 1%",
      "dosage":        "Apply a thin layer",
      "frequency":     "Twice daily",
      "duration":      "14 days",
      "notes":         null
    }
  ]
}
\end{lstlisting}

\textbf{Validation Rules}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{4cm} L{3.5cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \tblhdr{Field} & \tblhdr{Rules} & \tblhdr{Notes} \\
    \midrule
    \texttt{appointment\_id} & required, uuid, exists & Must reference an existing
                                                        appointment. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{diagnosis}       & required, string        & Free-text clinical diagnosis. \\
    \texttt{notes}           & nullable, string        & Overall prescription notes. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{items}           & required, array, min:1  & At least one item required. \\
    \texttt{items.*.medicine\_name} & required, string & Name of the drug. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{items.*.dosage}        & required, string & Dose per administration. \\
    \texttt{items.*.frequency}     & required, string & Frequency instruction. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{items.*.duration}      & required, string & Course duration. \\
    \texttt{items.*.notes}         & nullable, string & Per-item notes. \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

\textbf{Success Response --- HTTP 201 Created}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Prescription created successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id":             "1e2f3a4b-5c6d-7e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b",

    "doctor_id":      "9d2b1f4e-3a7c-4e8d-b1f2-3a7c4e8db1f2",

%% =========================================================================
\section{Assistant Endpoints}
\label{sec:ep-assistant}
%% =========================================================================

All Assistant endpoints are grouped under the
\route{/api/v1/assistant/} prefix and require both the
\texttt{role:assistant} middleware and the \texttt{clinic.scope}
middleware. The authenticated assistant's \texttt{clinic\_id} is
automatically injected into every request and cannot be overridden by
the client.

%% ── EP-ASS-1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\subsection{Query Available Appointment Slots}
\label{ep:assistant-available-slots}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{3cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\tblhdr{GET \quad /api/v1/assistant/available-slots}} \\
    \midrule
    Authentication & Bearer token required \\
    \rowalt
    Role Required  & \texttt{assistant} \\
    Clinic Scope   & Enforced \\
    \rowalt
    Query Params   & \texttt{doctor\_id} (required, UUID),
                     \texttt{date} (required, \texttt{YYYY-MM-DD}) \\
    \rowalt
    Success Status & \stok{} \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

Computes and returns the list of available appointment start times for a
specific doctor on a specific date. The algorithm loads the doctor's
\phpclass{DoctorSchedule} for the corresponding day of the week,
generates all candidate slots at \texttt{slot\_duration}-minute
intervals, and subtracts any slots already occupied by
non-cancelled appointments.

\textbf{Example Request}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=bash]
GET /api/v1/assistant/available-slots
    ?doctor_id=9d2b1f4e-3a7c-4e8d-b1f2-3a7c4e8db1f2
    &date=2026-07-07
\end{lstlisting}

\textbf{Success Response --- HTTP 200 OK}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Available slots retrieved successfully.",
  "data": {
    "doctor_id":     "9d2b1f4e-3a7c-4e8d-b1f2-3a7c4e8db1f2",
    "date":          "2026-07-07",
    "slot_duration": 30,
    "available_slots": [
      "09:00",
      "09:30",
      "10:30",
      "11:00",
      "11:30",
      "12:00",
      "12:30",
      "13:00",
      "13:30"
    ]
  }
}
\end{lstlisting}

\begin{notebox}[Empty Slots Array]
  If the doctor has no schedule entry for the given date's day of the
  week, or if all slots are already booked, the
  \texttt{available\_slots} array is empty. This is a valid \stok{}
  response, not an error.
\end{notebox}

\label{ep:assistant-patients-store}

\begin{table}[h!]

    Success Status & \stcreated{} \\

Creates a new patient record within the authenticated assistant's

\textbf{Request Body}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "name":          "Youssef Mansour",
  "phone":         "+20-111-555-6666",
  "email":         "youssef.m@example.com",
  "date_of_birth": "1995-07-14",
  "gender":        "male",
  "address":       "5 Ahmed Orabi Street, Giza"

\end{lstlisting}

\textbf{Validation Rules}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{3.5cm} L{4cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \tblhdr{Field} & \tblhdr{Rules} & \tblhdr{Notes} \\
    \midrule
    \texttt{name}          & required, string             & Full legal name. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{phone}         & required, string,
                             unique:patients,phone,NULL,id,clinic\_id
                             & Unique within the clinic. \\
    \texttt{email}         & nullable, email              & Optional. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{date\_of\_birth} & required, date, before:today & ISO 8601 date. \\
    \texttt{gender}        & required, in:male,female     & Backed enum value. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{address}       & nullable, string             & Free-text address. \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

%% ── EP-ASS-8 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\subsection{Book Appointment}
\label{ep:assistant-appointments-store}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{3cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\tblhdr{POST \quad /api/v1/assistant/appointments}} \\
    \midrule
    Authentication & Bearer token required \\
    \rowalt
    Role Required  & \texttt{assistant} \\
    Clinic Scope   & Enforced \\
    \rowalt
    Restrictions   & The requested slot must be available (within the
                     doctor's schedule and not already booked). A
                     distributed cache lock prevents concurrent
                     double-booking. \\
    \rowalt
    Success Status & \stcreated{} \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

Books an appointment by linking a patient to a doctor's available slot.
The system:
\begin{enumerate}
  \item Acquires a distributed \texttt{Cache::lock} keyed to
    \texttt{appointment\_slot:\{doctor\_id\}:\{date\}:\{start\_time\}}.
  \item Validates that the requested \texttt{start\_time} appears in
    the computed available slots for that doctor and date.
  \item Computes \texttt{end\_time} as
    \texttt{start\_time + slot\_duration}.
  \item Persists the appointment record with status \texttt{pending}.
  \item Dispatches the \texttt{SendAppointmentConfirmation} job
    asynchronously.
  \item Releases the lock.
\end{enumerate}

\textbf{Request Body}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "doctor_id":        "9d2b1f4e-3a7c-4e8d-b1f2-3a7c4e8db1f2",
  "patient_id":       "6d7e8f9a-0b1c-2d3e-4f5a-6b7c8d9e0f1a",
  "appointment_date": "2026-07-07",
  "start_time":       "10:00",
  "notes":            "First visit. Patient complains of knee pain."
}
\end{lstlisting}

\textbf{Validation Rules}

\begin{table}[h!]
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}L{4cm} L{3.5cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \tblhdr{Field} & \tblhdr{Rules} & \tblhdr{Notes} \\
    \midrule
    \texttt{doctor\_id}        & required, uuid, exists:users,id
                                 & Must be a Doctor-role user in the same clinic. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{patient\_id}       & required, uuid, exists:patients,id
                                 & Must belong to the same clinic. \\
    \texttt{appointment\_date} & required, date, after\_or\_equal:today
                                 & Cannot book in the past. \\
    \rowalt
    \texttt{start\_time}       & required, date\_format:H:i
                                 & Must match an available slot. \\
    \texttt{notes}             & nullable, string            & Optional booking notes. \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

\textbf{Success Response --- HTTP 201 Created}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json]
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Appointment booked successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id":               "7e8f9a0b-1c2d-3e4f-5a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b",
    "doctor_id":        "9d2b1f4e-3a7c-4e8d-b1f2-3a7c4e8db1f2",

    "clinic_id":        "1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d",
    "booked_by":        "4d5e6f7a-8b9c-0d1e-2f3a-4b5c6d7e8f9a",
    "appointment_date": "2026-07-07",
    "start_time":       "10:00",
    "end_time":         "10:30",
    "status":           "pending",
    "notes":            "First visit. Patient complains of knee pain.",
    "doctor": {
      "id":   "9d2b1f4e-3a7c-4e8d-b1f2-3a7c4e8db1f2",
      "name": "Dr. Sarah Khalil"
    },
    "patient": {
      "id":   "6d7e8f9a-0b1c-2d3e-4f5a-6b7c8d9e0f1a",

    }
  }

%% =========================================================================
\section{Common Error Response Reference}
\label{sec:common-errors}
%% =========================================================================

The following error shapes are returned consistently across all endpoints.

\begin{table}[h!]
  \centering
  \caption{Common HTTP error responses and their trigger conditions.}
  \label{tab:common-errors}
  \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.5}
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}C{2.5cm} X@{}}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{PrimaryBlue}
    \tblhdr{Status} & \tblhdr{Trigger and Shape} \\
    \midrule
    \stunauth{}
      & Missing, malformed, or revoked bearer token. The
        \texttt{auth:api} Passport middleware terminates the request.
        \newline
        \texttt{\{"success": false, "message": "Unauthenticated."\}} \\
    \rowalt
    \stforbid{}
      & Role mismatch (\phpclass{RoleMiddleware}); cross-clinic access
        (\phpclass{ClinicScopeViolationException}); self-demotion
        attempt (\phpclass{SelfDemotionException}); deactivated account
        (\phpclass{AccountDeactivatedException}).
        \newline
        \texttt{\{"success": false, "message": "<context-specific message>"\}} \\
    \stnotfound{}
      & Route model binding failed to resolve the UUID path parameter
        to an existing record (\texttt{ModelNotFoundException}).
        \newline
        \texttt{\{"success": false, "message": "Resource not found."\}} \\
    \rowalt
    \stconflict{}
      & A booking or reschedule request targets a slot that is already
        occupied (\phpclass{AppointmentConflictException}).
        \newline
        \texttt{\{"success": false, "message": "The requested appointment slot is not available."\}} \\
    \stunproc{}
      & Form request validation failure (structured field errors under
        \texttt{"errors"} key); or an operation on a resource in an
        incompatible state
        (\phpclass{InvalidAppointmentStateException}).
        \newline
        \texttt{\{"success": false, "errors": \{"field": ["message"]\}\}} \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabularx}
\end{table}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json, caption={HTTP 422 validation failure envelope.}]
{
  "success": false,
  "errors": {
    "email":    ["The email field is required."],
    "password": ["The password must be at least 8 characters."]
  }
}
\end{lstlisting}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=json, caption={HTTP 404 resource not found envelope.}]
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Resource not found."
}
\end{lstlisting}
